default:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[2] = default<S[2]>(); print(a[0].x); }
limited-default:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[..3] = default<S[..3]>(); print(a.len); }
fill:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var s: S = S { x: 9 }; var a: S[2] = [s; 2]; print(a[1].x); }
push:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[..3] = [S { x: 1 }]; var s: S = S { x: 2 }; a.push(s); print(a.len); }
pop:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[..3] = [S { x: 1 }]; var s: S = a.pop(); print(s.x); }
discard-pop:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[..3] = [S { x: 1 }]; a.pop(); print(a.len); }
iteration:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[1] = [S { x: 1 }]; for s in a { print(s.x); } }
equality:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[1] = [S { x: 1 }]; var b: S[1] = [S { x: 1 }]; print(a == b); }
assign:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[1] = [S { x: 1 }]; var b: S = S { x: 2 }; a[0] = b; print(a[0].x); }
adaptation:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[1] = [S { x: 1 }]; var b: S[..2] = a; print(b[0].x); }
nested:
struct S { x: i64 = 7 }
fn main() { var a: S[1][1] = [[S { x: 1 }]]; print(a[0][0].x); }
